articles.title: Today’s Vergecast: Mike Schur has five minutes to get your attention.
articles.summary:
Mike Schur is the driving force behind some of the great TV comedies, from Parks & Recreation to Brooklyn Nine-Nine to Man On The Inside to The Good Place. Now he’s back, with a new show called Dig. He joins the show to explain why first episodes matter more than ever, why a mystery can help a comedy, the kinds of shows that get made in 2026, and much more.

articles.title: WWE Raw results, grades (Nov. 23): Roman Reigns and the 946 raise the stakes; Ethan Page retains
articles.summary: The latest "WWE Raw" unveiled the final members for Team USA and Team Mexico, and put some finishing touches on this weekend’s Survivor Series: WarGames matches.
articles.body: "WWE Raw" traveled to Wichita, Kansas on this Monday, Nov. 23, for a special early edition of the show. Tonight's "Raw" unveiled the final members for Team USA and Team Mexico, while further putting the finishing touches on teases for this weekend’s Survivor Series: WarGames matches.Instant actionWWE started tonight’s "Raw" in a very old-school fashion. Instead of showing wrestler arrivals like WWE usually does these days, as soon as the show began, 946 was assaulting Alpha Academy. Those poor dudes can't catch a break.The 946 are on a total TEAR!! 🤯Tozawa and Otis have been DESTROYED!! pic.twitter.com/UqScGTdDWm— WWE (@WWE) November 23, 2026 Michael Cole explained on commentary that Alpha Academy had just finished their match on “WWE Main Event” before they were attacked. The mention was a nice touch, explaining what exactly was going down, and giving that always-fun unpredictability element to the 946’s "Ain't nobody safe" mantra. Then every member got a turn on the mic, punctuated by Royce Keys finally giving some semblance of a verbal explanation of how we got here.It's crazy that it took this long, but better late than never.Nobody is SAFE from The 946! 😤 pic.twitter.com/5QlAeqL7Fx— WWE (@WWE) November 23, 2026 Keys made it clear he intends to take out the Bloodline, then Roman Reigns, securing the World Heavyweight Title in the process. That would be a logical progression, for sure.Reigns was expected to show up tonight, so it boiled down to when — which, of course, was the end of the show. Admittedly, it was a bit of a dud closer for the Survivor Series go-home "Raw" because they just brawled as the show went off air. At the same time, they don't have much else to do at this point until Saturday’s match.WarGames on Saturday is about to go CRAZY!!! 🔥⛓️The Bloodline and 946 will be LOCKED for WAR!! pic.twitter.com/ng4zn9mjl8— WWE (@WWE) November 24, 2026 You know, I say they don't have anything else they could do, but wrestling is an option, of course. It's kind of their job, after all.Throwing until it sticksSeth Rollins is back, and that's a good thing. How we got to it is not.If you watched last Friday's "SmackDown,” you'll have seen just how great everything has been so far with the whole Team USA vs. Team Mexico tag match. It's been genuinely silly in a pretty great way, which feels very weird but refreshing, especially for the stars involved: Cody Rhodes and CM Punk, specifically.The whole concept is circling around those two and their brewing dissension, with Punk anointing himself a team co-captain and Rhodes' slow heel turn. (Hopefully.) So, in a vacuum, Rhodes bringing in Punk's forever rival, Rollins, is brilliant. But if you really think about it, it makes no sense whatsoever and makes almost everyone on Team USA look like an idiot.BURN IT DOWN 🔥 Seth Rollins is the FINAL member of Team USA! @WWERollins pic.twitter.com/23TACTdPoh— WWE (@WWE) November 24, 2026 Sooo... this is awkward 😬@CMPunk | @WWERollins pic.twitter.com/gffAgSk8yh— WWE (@WWE) November 24, 2026 For starters, why would Rollins want to be on a team with Punk in a virtually meaningless match? Not only him, but another rival from the past two years, LA Knight, who in-story has entirely forgotten that he had issues with Punk in the past, too. Even Rhodes! Je'Von Evans is the only one on their team who is just there and cool with everyone.Now, if Rollins' reason is that he just wants to keep annoying Punk for all of eternity, then OK. Did he just want something to do after being left off TV since SummerSlam? Either would be fine and make sense, but at least make it clear. WWE didn't even give the dude mic time tonight, which was a wildly anticlimactic way to end the segment.That's just from one perspective, though. Then you have Rhodes. He knows Punk and Rollins' history, and he blatantly acknowledged it on Friday — up until tonight. He acted like he had no other choice, which is painfully untrue. So, unless he just wanted to be a jerk as payback for Punk's arrogance around the captain status, he willingly made a decision that actually gives his team a worse chance to win. Surely, this also gives WWE a perfect excuse to have Team Mexico win in a scenario where it otherwise would have zero chance.The situation on Team USA has become TENSE to say the least! 🫢 pic.twitter.com/q5BNPq4pBG— WWE (@WWE) November 24, 2026 El Grande returnsEl Grande Americano was revealed as the final member of Team Mexico. It's absolutely incredible when you think about it. The man under the mask belongs to neither country, but currently could have fit on either side for maximum hilarity. Overall, it's just incredible to see Ludwig Kaiser even get this opportunity in a match with all these stars involved. You love to see it.EL GRANDE AMERICANO 🇲🇽Welcome to Team Mexico!! pic.twitter.com/rvLB2nsyGH— WWE (@WWE) November 23, 2026 A missed opportunity for poor Chad Gable getting left out.Breaking down the Vision?Oba Femi essentially still has nothing to do on this show. That's incredibly disappointing in its own right, especially when you hear the reactions this guy generates. But now, Femi has thrown down an ultimatum after being surrounded by The Vision backstage upon his arrival: Stand down or get destroyed."STAND DOWN" ⚠️@Obaofwwe has given The Vision the ultimate warning! pic.twitter.com/33hpkbz2to— WWE (@WWE) November 24, 2026 It feels like an odd route to take, and as much as I want to see every WWE stable outside of the 946 disband, Bron Breakker should be the one to separate from or end The Vision. That, unfortunately, doesn't seem in the cards. That's unless they "stand down" and he disbands them, I suppose.All in all, it's an odd path to take.👑 Uncrowned Gem of the Night 👑Ethan Page and Rey Fenix came out sprinting in their Intercontinental title match. It was a good change of pace for the champion, Page, who retained and reminded fans he can go at a rate like this.The best part of this was Page winning with more "legal cheating." Like, the win wasn't dirty. It was tactfully underhanded, you could say, as Page pulled Fenix's mask to the side, forcing a readjustment. From there, he capitalized and hit his finisher for the win. EGO CHECK ✅@OfficialEGO RETAINS the IC Title! pic.twitter.com/wyfR8OaOvY— WWE (@WWE) November 23, 2026 I mean, this is some really intricate, subtly strong booking for Page. He has been in a great spot since earning his title match.I give Monday's "Raw" a crown score of: 👑 7/10 👑WWE Raw full-card results and match grades:Stephanie Vaquer and Bayley def. Fatal Influence (Fallon Henley and Lainey Reid) — 👑 3.5/5 👑Sol Ruca def. Lyra Valkyria — 👑 3/5 👑Rey Mysterio and El Grande Americano def. The Judgment Day (Dominik Mysterio and JD McDonagh) — 👑 3.75/5 👑Intercontinental Championship: Ethan Page (c) def. Rey Fenix — 👑 4/5 👑Recap "WWE Raw" with Uncrowned's live blog:

articles.title: Bengals vs. Commanders live updates, inactives, where to watch: Joe Burrow MVP watch continues on 'Monday Night Football'
articles.summary: The Bengals have scored at least 31 points in five straight games. Can they extend the streak to six against the Commanders on "Monday Night Football"?
articles.body: The Cincinnati Bengals and Washington Commanders will close out the Week 11 game slate on "Monday Night Football," with kickoff set for 8:15 p.m. ET at Northwest Stadium in Landover, Maryland.The Commanders defense will have its hands full attempting to contain Joe Burrow and the Bengals offense, which has been on an absolute tear as of late, scoring 31-plus points in each of their past five games. Burrow has emerged as the NFL MVP favorite, leading the league in passing yards per game (310.6), passing touchdowns (27) and completion rate (74.7%) on the way to a 7-2 record and the lead in the AFC North.Though Washington is 3-5-1, its season is far from over. The Commanders are 2.5 games behind the first-place New York Giants in the NFC East, and after a Week 5 tie and a Week 10 win over New York, they hold the head-to-head tiebreaker. A couple of wins down the stretch could put them squarely in the race.Follow along with Yahoo Sports for live updates, highlights and more as the Bengals and Commanders close out Week 11 on "Monday Night Football," airing on ABC and ESPN.

articles.title: Spotify down: Company says outage fixed after 40-minute disruption; users can access accounts and stream music again
articles.summary: Spotify says it has fixed an outage that left tens of thousands of users unable to access the music streaming platform on November 24.
articles.body: Spotify says it has fixed an outage that left tens of thousands of users unable to access the music streaming platform on November 24. The disruption lasted around 40 minutes, with some users reporting that they had been logged out of their accounts and were unable to sign back in. The company has now confirmed that its services are recovering, meaning users should be able to access their libraries and resume streaming music. “Everything’s looking much better now. Thanks for your patience. If you still need help, get in touch at Spotify's status account on X shared the update at 7:08 am ET (5:38 PM IST).What happened during the Spotify outageReports of problems began around 6:29 a.m. ET, according to outage tracker Downdetector. The number of complaints increased over the next few minutes, with users reporting trouble accessing the app and logging into their accounts.Spotify acknowledged the disruption at 6:56 a.m. ET, saying it was aware of the issues and was investigating them.Several users also took to X to report that they had been unexpectedly logged out of their accounts. Some Premium subscribers said they were being asked to create new accounts when they tried to sign in again. Others reported problems receiving login codes through email, making it difficult to regain access.Spotify says services are back, but what caused the outageSpotify has not yet shared what caused Tuesday's disruption. The company has also not provided a detailed explanation of the technical problem behind the login and access issues. Since the outage lasted less than an hour and has now been resolved, it remains unclear whether Spotify will release further details.Users who are still experiencing problems have been asked to report them through Spotify's support channels.Fearless legend or grounded realist?
